name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's is the largest restaurant chain by system sales ($139.4B in 2025) with 45,356 restaurants, 95% franchised. It makes most of its money as a landlord and brand owner: franchisees pay rent (a percent of sales, with minimums) and royalties, and the company owns or leases much of the property. It also runs some restaurants itself, mainly in the largest international markets, where it books the full restaurant sales and costs. The US and International Operated Markets segments earned $12,190M of the $12,393M total operating income (98%). Growth is from new restaurants in licensed markets and from comparable sales and loyalty (70 loyalty markets, about $37B of loyalty-member system sales in 2025).
